finalJustifications: Because Multipart Upload divides into parts (≥5 MB) sent independently and in parallel: failed a part, forwards only it — never the entire file.
Because Multipart Upload changes the TCP for UDP in large parts, eliminating the timeouts of unstable connections.
Because Multipart Upload saves progress on the disk from AWS each second, returning the sending of the exact point of the fall.
Because Multipart Upload compresses the file by half before sending, reducing the total transfer time.
